name: reqweaver
description: Schedule planner for banking college credit in high school

scripts.test: npm run build && lsc -c -o lib/test test/helpers.ls test/planner.ls test/overrides.ls test/rules.ls test/scoring.ls test/encoder.ls test/run.ls && node lib/test/run.js
scripts.build:web: npm run build && node lib/tools/webdata.js && esbuild lib/ui/app.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --legal-comments=none --outfile=public/app.js && esbuild lib/worker.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --legal-comments=none --outfile=public/worker.js
